bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears are dealing with uncertainty at quarterback ahead of Monday night's home game against the Philadelphia Eagles, as coach Ben Johnson has said the starting quarterback for Monday night's home game against the Eagles won't be determined until later in the week, though he's comfortable with every option . Injured QB Caleb Williams appears to have caught a break, as after suffering a non-contact hamstring injury during the Week 2 loss to the Vikings, a new report suggests he has avoided a significant injury , while the team also got a boost with left tackle Ozzy Trapilo continuing to work without restrictions and defensive lineman Shemar Turner and linebacker Noah Sewell returning to practice for the first time this year .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are preparing for their Week 3 matchup against the New York Jets, coming off a Week 2 loss to the Buffalo Bills, with analysts noting the game is important for Detroit as head coach Dan Campbell needs to prove the team's Super Bowl window is still open . Practice reports from Thursday show the team fine-tuning preparations, with defensive coordinator Kelvin Sheppard's approach to the mini-bye and wide receiver Isaac TeSlaa's role on offense among the storylines heading into Sunday's game against Aaron Glenn's Jets defense.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers suffered a lopsided home loss on Thursday Night Football, as the Falcons dominated the Pack after Green Bay energized fans by picking off Michael Penix Jr. on the opening drive .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The biggest Vikings story from the past 24 hours centers on star running back Aaron Jones, who missed Wednesday's practice with a knee injury after carrying the ball 23 times in Sunday's win over the Bears, then was back at practice on Thursday in a limited capacity after missing Wednesday's session . Jones came out of the weekend "a little banged up," though O'Connell said Jones had "turned over" and was feeling great and bouncing around like normal , giving the 2-0 Vikings hope he'll be available for Sunday's Week 3 matchup at Tampa Bay.
